newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: TENNIS-UNSEEDED DOSEDEL WINS AMSTERDAM TITLE.
newsitem.headline: TENNIS-UNSEEDED DOSEDEL WINS AMSTERDAM TITLE.

text.p: Unseeded Czech Slava Dosedel surprised top seed Carlos Moya of Spain to win the $475,000 Amsterdam Open in four sets on Sunday.

Dosedel, ranked 59th in the world, played a hard-hitting game to keep his 10th-ranked opponent on the run throughout a match lasting just over three and a half hours and clinched a 7-6 7-6 6-7 6-2 victory .
"It was a really good match...my best tournament win so far," a beaming Dosedel said afterwards.
"Looking back, I played a good tournament, although obviously I am disappointed I didn't win," said Moya, who also lost out to Dosedel in Munich last year.
"All I can do is come back again next year," he said.
The Czech fell 3-1 behind in the opening set but broke back to force a tie break which he won 7-4 and went on to take the second, also in a tie-break.
Although the Spaniard recovered to take the third set in another tie-break, Dosedel dominated the fourth, winning it comfortably.
